key_exact_public_headers.kernel_fixed_base:
theorem coupled_circle_kernel_grading_bounds :
    ∃ base loss : ℕ, ∀ (r k s : ℕ) (R : ℝ), 1 ≤ R →
      ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ ψ : M.Space, M.grading base ψ ≤ R →
        ∀ (v : M.Space) (w : Fin k → M.Space),
          M.grading s (coupledCircleKernel hD hT hγ hM hI r k ψ v w) ≤
            C * coupledCircleKernelMajorant M base (r + s + loss) ψ (Fin.cons v w)
key_exact_public_headers.full_scalar_jet_formula:
theorem circleChartCompositionJets_apply (hS : IsCircleModel T γ S)
    (travel : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : S.Space × S.Space)
    (v : Fin n → S.Space × S.Space) (m : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    circleChartCompositionJets hS travel n x v m θ =
      iteratedDeriv n (S.decode x.2 m) (circleCompositionPhase travel x m θ) *
        ∏ i, S.decode (v i).1 m θ +
      ∑ i : Fin n, iteratedDeriv (n - 1) (S.decode (v i).2 m)
          (circleCompositionPhase travel x m θ) *
        ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, S.decode (v j).1 m θ
key_exact_public_headers.genuine_full_tower:
theorem exists_circleChartComposition_smoothDirections
    (hS : IsCircleModel T γ S) (hT : IsMaterialData D T)
    (hD : IsAccumulatingProfile D) (hγ : 0 < γ)
    (hinterp : HasInterpolation S.grading) (travel : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∃ J : SmoothDirections univ
      (fun x : S.Space × S.Space =>
        circleShiftedChartComposeContinuousLinear hS hT hD hγ travel x.1 x.2),
      ∀ n x (v : Fin n → S.Space × S.Space),
        S.decode (J.D n x v) = circleChartCompositionJets hS travel n x v
key_exact_public_headers.translation_all_orders:
theorem circleTranslationContinuousLinear_grading_le
    (hS : IsCircleModel T γ S) (hT : IsMaterialData D T)
    (hD : IsAccumulatingProfile D) (hγ : 0 < γ) (travel : ℕ → ℝ)
    (s : ℕ) (u : S.Space) :
    S.grading s (circleTranslationContinuousLinear hS hT hD hγ travel u) ≤ S.grading s u

theorem circleShiftedChartCompose_fullJets_fixedBase_oneHigh
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {gamma : ℝ} {M : CircleModelData}
    (hD : IsAccumulatingProfile D) (hT : IsMaterialData D T)
    (hgamma : 0 < gamma) (hM : IsCircleModel T gamma M)
    (hI : HasInterpolation M.grading) :
    ∃ B ell : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ R : ℝ, 1 ≤ R → ∀ s : ℕ,
      ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (travel : ℕ → ℝ)
        (J : SmoothDirections univ (fun x : M.Space × M.Space =>
          circleShiftedChartComposeContinuousLinear hM hT hD hgamma travel x.1 x.2)),
      ∀ x : M.Space × M.Space,
        pairGrading M.grading M.grading B x ≤ R →
      ∀ v : Fin n → M.Space × M.Space,
        M.grading s (J.D n x v) ≤
          C * tameJetSize (pairGrading M.grading M.grading) n s (n + ell) B x v

numerical_proof.common_high: For N=n+1 take h=s+(N+ell); the main kernel has r=N, the deleted kernels r=n. Promote only the deleted high index from n+s+ell to N+s+ell via coupledCircleKernelMajorant_mono_high. B is unchanged.
numerical_proof.main_term: Under p_B x<=R and R>=1, Majorant(B,h,x.1,Fin.cons(T_t x.2, v.fst)) <= R*tameJetSize p N s (N+ell) B x v. Translation contracts all q_j. The two source coefficients (1+q_h x.1)*q_B x.2+q_h x.2 are <=R*(1+p_h x); every derivative-direction high term has a source low factor <=R.
numerical_proof.deleted_source_term: For each i:Fin N, Majorant(B,h,x.1,Fin.cons(T_t(v_i.snd),other v.fst)) <= tameJetSize p N s (N+ell) B x v. Reindex exactly to the N original direction slots; each appears once. Pair-grading projections dominate both components, and 1+q_h x.1<=1+p_h x.
numerical_proof.constant: For N>0 choose C=R*C_main+(N:Real)*C_deleted. For N=0 choose C=R*C_main. Seminorm sum/add subadditivity and the finite sum of N identical tame majorants finish. Constants may depend on N,R,s but are chosen before travel and J.
numerical_proof.normalization: No new multilinear normalization or private inverseInputProfile_product is needed for this leaf: the public kernel majorant already has exactly one high input. All factor estimates are direct finite products and sums.
numerical_proof.weight: Every kernel and translation remains in the original M.grading. Thus the same physical H(sample m)^gamma weight is retained; it is not reconstructed from an unweighted UniformSmoothFamilyOn wrapper.
